incidents.what_happened: An LPG tanker crash on the Jaipur-Ajmer highway set off a fire that engulfed nearby vehicles, including a sleeper bus heading to Jaipur, killing at least seven people.
incidents.quote: An official said a sleeper bus headed for Jaipur from Rajsamand was behind the gas tanker when the accident occurred.

incidents.what_happened: A Japanese woman tourist walking to a temple near Amer Fort was harassed by five men and escaped by running to the fort security guards.
incidents.quote: She showed outstanding self-control when she escaped and ran to the fort security guards.

incidents.what_happened: A local tourist guide was stabbed during a dispute over vehicle entry near Maota Lake and Amer Fort and died in hospital.
incidents.quote: The seriously injured Manish was admitted to SMS Hospital where he died during treatment.
